raw_text: The viral Modi-Xi G20 handshake image is a fascinating case study in AI-generated political imagery. Stylistically it's consistent with Midjourney v5.x output — the photorealistic quality, the specific way fabrics are rendered, and the characteristic handling of skin textures. What makes this notable in the AI art community is not the generation itself but the distribution vector: it escaped the AI-art context entirely and was consumed as news photography. This highlights a critical gap in media literacy. No C2PA metadata, no visible watermark, no disclosure. The image was likely generated in under 60 seconds with a simple text prompt. We need provenance standards urgently.
